events.name: New York Giants at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Eli Manning didn't need a big comeback Thursday night, not with Andre Brown running for a career-high 113 yards and two touchdowns in the New York Giants' 36-7 victory over the Carolina Panthers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backups Brown, Barden shine as Giants cruise

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Major Wright returned an interception 45 yards for a touchdown, and the Chicago Bears beat the St. Louis Rams 23-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wright's pick-six highlights big day for Bears' D

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw three touchdown passes and the Bills overcame the loss of running back C.J. Spiller to beat the Cleveland Browns 24-14 on Sunday, snapping an eight-game road losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spiller hurt, but Bills snap road losing streak

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray had an 11-yard touchdown run, Dan Bailey kicked three field goals and the Dallas Cowboys beat Tampa Bay 16-10 Sunday to win their home opener with a delayed ending.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys hold off Bucs to win home opener

headlines.description: Rob Bironas kicked a 26-yard field goal in overtime, and the Titans stopped backup quarterback Shaun Hill on fourth-and-1 at the Tennessee 7 to finally pull out a 44-41 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans stuff Lions at 7 to win wild OT thriller

headlines.description: Jacksonville's Blaine Gabbert connected with Cecil Shorts III on a 80-yard TD pass with 45 seconds left to beat the Colts 22-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gabbert lifts Jags past Colts with long TD pass

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.shortLinkText: Jets edge Dolphins in OT as Folk gets reprieve

headlines.description: Christian Ponder threw two touchdown passes to tight end Kyle Rudolph and ran for another score to help the Vikings hand the 49ers their first defeat, 24-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ponder, Rudolph pace Vikings in upset of 49ers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Ryan Succop kicked six field goals, one to force overtime in the final seconds and another from 31 yards to lift the Kansas City Chiefs to a 27-24 victory over the winless New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Charles, Chiefs rally to top Saints in OT stunner

headlines.description: Andy Dalton completed 19-of-27 passes for 328 yards and three touchdowns Sunday to lead the Cincinnati Bengals to a 38-31 win over Robert Griffin III and the Washington Redskins.

Kevin Kolb threw for 222 yards and two touchdowns, James Sanders returned one of Michael Vick's two fumbles 93 yards for a touchdown and the Cardinals ran over the Eagles 27-6 on Sunday for their best start in 38 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards drub Eagles for 1st 3-0 start since 1974

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw touchdown passes to three different receivers and safety Thomas DeCoud had two interceptions and a fumble recovery for the Atlanta Falcons, who overwhelmed the San Diego Chargers 27-3 Sunday to remain undefeated.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan shines as Falcons D shuts down Chargers

headlines.description: Matt Schaub outplayed Peyton Manning on Sunday, throwing four touchdown passes against a confused Denver defense to lead the Houston Texans to a 31-25 victory over the Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schaub's 4 TDs help Texans by Broncos

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski kicked a 43-yard field goal on the last play as the Oakland Raiders scored the final 13 points after wide receiver Darrius Heyward-Bey was knocked out and hospitalized by a scary hit to beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 34-31.
headlines.shortLinkText: Janikowski FG caps Raiders' rally over Steelers

events.name: New England Patriots at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 27-yard field goal as time expired, giving the Baltimore Ravens a 31-30 victory over the New England Patriots on Sunday night in a rematch of the AFC championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grieving WR Smith shines as Ravens edge Pats

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a disputed 24-yard touchdown to Golden Tate on the final play of the game, and the Seattle Seahawks rallied to beat the Green Bay Packers 14-12 on Monday night in a controversial ending.
headlines.shortLinkText: Controversial call hands Seahawks bizarre win
